current_status.to: Active as of 2026-09-23. Adopted unanimously as Article 7 at the May 4, 2026 Annual Town Meeting (Part 1), establishing a one-year moratorium on Building-Integrated Energy Storage Systems (BESS) of 50 kWh or more and on Data Centers, running through 2027-05-03 or earlier supersession by new zoning. Town Counsel Donna MacNicol told voters before the vote that the BESS portion was unlikely to survive Attorney General review because standalone BESS is treated as a protected/solar-adjacent use under G.L. c. 48, Section 3, and recommended splitting the article into two motions; voters instead approved the combined article as written (several Massachusetts towns, including Blandford, Worthington, and Wendell, had similar BESS moratoria disapproved by the AGO's Municipal Law Unit in 2026). No Attorney General Municipal Law Unit decision specific to this Gill bylaw was located as of 2026-09-23. The Gill Planning Board's Sept. 17, 2026 meeting agenda lists 'Review Data Centers for bylaw updates,' consistent with continuing work toward permanent regulations during the moratorium period.
current_status.reason: Updates status to reflect adoption, the town counsel's contemporaneous legal caveat about the BESS portion, and confirmation the moratorium remains in force with no AG decision found.
